{{PAGENAME}}, as well as the other variants ([[Dark brain]], [[Dark heart]]), will randomly appear on newly delivered corpses. Obtained after progressing far enough through the [[Inquisitor]] quest-line.

==Quest==
===Quest===
The [[Inquisitor]] needs evidence for the presence of an occult in the [[town]] to convince the king of the inquisition's plans. For this, he asks you to bring him one {{PAGENAME}}, one [[Dark brain]] and one [[Dark heart]].
